issue.title: Bug: [ztp] ZTP cannot find IP6 default routes on eth0

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

Currently, all interfaces in a sonic device are set to be IPv6 forwarding interfaces. This causes an issue because they won't honor RA advertisements. Also, currently, the IPv6 `dhclient` gets a prefix allocation, so by default, the interface receives a /128 address from the DHCPv6 server with no default route. The default behavior of ZTP is to try to find a DHCP server using the default route, if it exists. If there is no IPv6 default route, ZTP will fail unless some alternative is provided.

To address this, `eth0` can be set to host mode in the ZTP config script, so that it will accept RA, perform SLAAC, and retrieve the remaining information from the DHCPv6 server.

### Steps to Reproduce

Try to configure ZTP using the default address method when `eth0` is configured with an IPv6 address only.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected: ZTP finds a DHCP server over the `eth0` IPv6 default route and completes successfully.

Actual: ZTP fails to find a DHCP server and hangs waiting for a server to be found, never completing.

resolution.title: Issue 24405: [ztp] Support ZTP on eth0 over v6-only network
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

ZTP needs to use Router Advertisements to detect DHCP default routes in V6 networks.

Closes #24405

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

Modify the interfaces.j2 template to support ZTP over v6 by using RA messages. This is done by setting accept_ra to 2, which allows the interface to accept RA messages.

#### How to verify it

Device is configurable using ZTP over ipv6 on eth0.
